# rcmake

> Independent drop-in reimplementation of CMake 4.5.1 in safe Rust. One binary runs as `cmake`, `ctest`, and `cpack`, reads existing `CMakeLists.txt` files, presets, and caches, and writes compatible build trees.

`rcmake` (`0.1.0`) contains no copied or translated CMake C++ source. All 35 workspace crates enforce `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`; some Rust dependencies (`rustix`, `memchr`) use `unsafe` internally, and the native binary statically links `zstd` 1.5.7 and `liblzma` 5.8. Rust and Python code is dual-licensed `MIT OR Apache-2.0`; bundled CMake 4.5.1 `Modules/`, `Templates/`, and `Help/` files stay under `BSD-3-Clause`. `rcmake` is not affiliated with Kitware. "CMake" is a trademark of Kitware, Inc.

## CMake 4.5.1 parity

- **CLI tools in one binary (`argv[0]` dispatch):** `cmake` (configure and generate, `-P` scripts, `-E` utilities, `--build`, `--install`, `--workflow`, `--find-package`, `--sarif-output`), `ctest` (parallel scheduling, fixtures, resource specifications, labels, repeat modes, JUnit and dashboard XML, `discover_tests()`, `-S` scripts), and `cpack` (archive generators `TGZ`, `TXZ`, `TZST`, `TBZ2`, `TZ`, `TAR`, `ZIP`, `7Z` and compression variants, `External`, macOS `DragNDrop` and `Bundle`).
- **Two execution modes:** Running as `cmake`, `ctest`, or `cpack` (or setting `RCMAKE_ORACLE_MODE=1`) selects CMake 4.5.1 compatibility mode. Running as `rcmake` selects native mode with the extensions below.
- **Generators:** `Ninja` and `Ninja Multi-Config` (macOS, Linux, Windows), `Unix Makefiles` (macOS, Linux), `Xcode` (macOS), and `Visual Studio 17 2022` and `Visual Studio 18 2026` (Windows).
- **Languages and tooling:** C (C90 to C23), C++ (including C++20 and C++23 named modules with Ninja `dyndep`), Objective-C, Objective-C++, Fortran (`.mod` dependency scanning), `ASM`/`ASM_MASM`/`ASM_NASM`, Windows `RC`, and Qt `AUTOMOC`/`AUTOUIC`/`AUTORCC`.
- **CMake 4.5.1 interfaces:** Policies `CMP0000` to `CMP0226` (`CMP0000` to `CMP0065` always NEW; 161 active policies `CMP0066` to `CMP0226`), Presets schema v13, File API (`codemodel` v2.12, `cache` v2, `toolchains` v1, `cmakeFiles` v1, `configureLog` v1), Common Package Specification (CPS) 0.15.0, SPDX 3.0.1 SBOM, Instrumentation API v1, `cmake_diagnostic()` with SARIF 2.1.0 output, and `compile_commands.json`.
- **Platforms:** Prebuilt releases target `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, and `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`. Intel macOS builds from source. `rcmake-api` also compiles for `wasm32-unknown-unknown` and `wasm32-wasip1`.

## Native extensions (`rcmake` mode)

- **Persistent compiler probe cache:** Reuses verified compiler check results across build directories and projects after validating recorded inputs by SHA-256 digest (`RCMAKE_PROBE_CACHE=readwrite|readonly|verify|off`, optional HTTPS/S3 remote cache).
- **Parallel compiler probes:** Runs up to four compile probes concurrently by default (`RCMAKE_PROBE_JOBS`), speculating only on literal compile checks, never `try_run` or `execute_process`.
- **Incremental configure replay:** Re-runs edited directory regions and replays unchanged subtrees when entry context and recorded inputs match. Disabled when a toolchain file (including `vcpkg`), configure preset, `-C`, or `PreLoad.cmake` is active.
- **`rcmake explain <NAME>`:** Traces target build flags and transitive usage chains, or variable assignments, as terminal text or `--json` (`rcmake-explain-v1`).
- **`--profile[=<dir>]`:** Writes `trace.json`, `stacks.folded`, and `flamegraph.html` for a configure run.
- **`--diagnostics=rich`:** Renders source spans and annotations in a terminal.
- **`--hermetic[=warn|strict]`:** Audits environment reads, file reads, subprocesses, and network access during configure.
- **`--fetch-lock=off|auto|update|frozen`:** Pins FetchContent archives and Git commits in `rcmake-fetch.lock`.
- **`rcmake-lsp`:** Stdio Language Server Protocol binary for `CMakeLists.txt` and `*.cmake` files (hover with evaluated values via `eval,stdio`, completion, go to definition, document symbols, semantic tokens, formatting).
- **`rcmake-api` and WebAssembly playground:** In-process Rust configure and `explain` API backed by `rcmake_host::Host` (`NativeHost` and in-memory `PureHost`), running in the browser with no server.

## Install

- Linux and macOS: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dvgyl/rcmake/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
- Linux and macOS with `cmake`, `ctest`, and `cpack` symlinks: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dvgyl/rcmake/main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- --alias-cmake`
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dvgyl/rcmake/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex` (pass `-AliasCmake` when running a downloaded copy to write aliases)
- From source (Rust 1.99.1 pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`, plus Python 3): `git clone https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake.git && cd rcmake && scripts/install.sh --from-source`

## Intentional differences and limits

- Reproducible `tar` and CPack archives always write uid 0 and gid 0.
- No `cmake-gui`, no `ccmake`, and no `--debugger` (DAP).
- No legacy extra generators (`CodeBlocks`, `CodeLite`, `Eclipse CDT4`, `Kate`, `Sublime Text 2`), no `MinGW`/`NMake`/`MSYS`/`Borland`/`Watcom` Makefiles, no `Green Hills MULTI`, no `FASTBuild`, and no Visual Studio 14, 15, or 16.
- No CPack native installers (`DEB`, `RPM`, `NSIS`, `WIX`, `productbuild`, `IFW`).
- `try_compile` runs in-process rather than invoking Ninja, Make, MSBuild, or xcodebuild, so MSBuild-only and Xcode-only generator attributes do not affect probes.
- `--version` prints `cmake version 4.5.1` on line 1 and `rcmake 0.1.0` on line 2.
- Partial or unverified languages: CUDA (one ecosystem fixture), HIP (rule wiring only), Swift (parsed, builds unverified).

## Site

- [Overview](https://dvgyl.github.io/rcmake/): Install commands, CMake 4.5.1 comparison, pipeline diagram, generators, languages, and FAQ.
- [Browser playground](https://dvgyl.github.io/rcmake/playground.html): WebAssembly workbench for configure, Ninja and Ninja Multi-Config generation, diagnostics, and `rcmake explain`.
- [Compatibility report](https://dvgyl.github.io/rcmake/dashboard.html): Verification results across 3-OS `Tests/RunCMake`, 62 core suites, 35 policy suites, 10 large C++ projects, a 240-repository sealed holdout, 64 `vcpkg` shards, soundness gates, and benchmarks.
- [Compatibility JSON](https://dvgyl.github.io/rcmake/data/latest.json): Machine-readable snapshot backing the compatibility report.
- [Full technical reference](https://dvgyl.github.io/rcmake/llms-full.txt): Extended technical reference with CLI flags, architecture, limits, and Q&A.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/README.md): Quick start, feature matrix, install options, troubleshooting, and local verification commands.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): Answers on CMake 4.5.1 parity, generators, vcpkg and Conan, native extensions, install, and limits.
- [Build write-up](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/docs/BUILD_WRITEUP.md): Differential testing methodology against CMake 4.5.1, bugs exposed by testing, limits, and reproduction commands.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Execution pipeline, resolution layers, map of all 35 crates, and the `Host` trait.
- [Architecture decision records](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/docs/ADR.md): 31 design records covering storage, generators, host isolation, and compatibility boundaries.
- [Environment variables](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/docs/ENV_VARS.md): Reference for `RCMAKE_*` variables.
- [Prior art and licences](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/docs/PRIOR_ART.md): Vendored assets, direct third-party dependencies, and archive codec licences.
- [rcmake-api README](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/crates/rcmake-api/README.md): Embedding configure and `explain` in Rust programs and WebAssembly targets.
- [rcmake-lsp README](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake/blob/main/crates/rcmake-lsp/README.md): Editor setup for VS Code, Neovim, Helix, Zed, Emacs, and CLion.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dvgyl/rcmake): Source code, releases, and parity bug report form.
